name: 飞书会话
access: Reuses the existing Feishu (Lark) account binding; this package asks for no second app ID, app secret or redirect URI
Archive authorization asks only for read-only IM scopes and reads chats/messages for the explicitly selected conversations on that existing account
Sending needs a second user-scope authorization and runs only through a host-dispatched, owner-confirmed message.send action; the archive authorization never grants sending
The package never spawns lark-cli, never reads the CLI credential profile, and never calls document, calendar or Minutes commands
No model calls, no workspace-wide scan, and no IM write method other than the single send action path

sourceCatalog.title: 飞书会话
sourceCatalog.body: 在已有飞书账号上归档已勾选的群聊与私信，按消息身份保留版本
sourceCatalog.note: 安装不等于授权。复用已有飞书账号，另开消息范围，不再连一次文档/日历；归档与发送分开授权，发送走行动平台且逐条确认，问一问不能发送。
